profile.summary: Only a life lived for others is worth living.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android Engineering - Better Together Team.
Developing Google Quick Share Android/Windows/iOS apps and services.

Led engineering team for Tap-To-Share on Quick Share Integration. Updated/scheduled/triaged bugs/tasks between teams. Successfully launched the Tap to Share project to public.
Kotlin readability

Worked on Quick Share Android API, applied API surfaces and created App UIs and sample applications.

Led engineering team for Quick Share Windows. Managed features, bug fixes, schedules, launches, and rollouts.
Successfully launched to the public: https://www.android.com/quick-share/with-windows-pc/

Language: Kotlin & Java for Android Quick Share service in GMSCore, C++/Dart for Windows.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Programming · Windows · Mobile Devices · Mobile Applications · Software Engineering · C++ · Git · Android · Test Automation · Software Development · Flutter · Dart · Mobile · Application Development · C · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Audio & Speech Team in Cloud & AI Group.
Developing MVA platform service which supports voice agents like Cortana and Alexa. Developed platform for Windows MR devices like Hololens and Immersive Headsets. Voice Command Processing. Language: C/C++/C#. Tools: Visual Studio, Unity

positions.title: Lead Integration Engineer
positions.description: Developed CityID/NameID for Mobile Phone (BREW/BrewMP/Android) – Mobile Caller ID & Location Information Service for Incoming Call and Call Log. Language: C/C++, Java. Tools: Visual Studio with TFS, ARM Development Suite 1.2, BrewMP SDK, Eclipse, ActivePerl, Android, Xcode

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
SBG Mobile Kirana Group.
Developed Bing Applet & Bing Proxy Server (Both in Azure Platform) for Mobile Feature Phones.
Servers: Developed OneApp Servers: Socket Server/GH’ of OneApp. (http://www.microsoft.com/en-us/news/press/2009/aug09/08-24oneapppr.aspx) - controlling/handling socket connection with Feature Phone. Design and implement socket controlling, multi-threading, HTML packet send/receive, and encryption.
Developed Bing, Email, and PhotoViewer Clients and Email Proxy and Photo Proxy Server.
Developed Integrated Logging System for OneApp Servers.
Used, Deployed & Tested in Windows Azure, SQL Azure for OneApp Platform.
Created multiple spec-related documents and posted at Wiki.
Primary language: C#, Java, JavaScript, J2ME, WCF, ASPX/ASHX/ASMX, IIS, SQL, LINQ

positions.title: Senior Research Engineering Manager
positions.locationName: Geumcheon District, Seoul, South Korea · On-site
positions.description:
Drove projects in new technology team as an engineering lead. Developed LGE's builtin mobile application such as: Wake-up call, Scheduler, Alarm, Mobile TV (SDMB), Subway Pathfinder, Bluetooth
Developed Bluetooth profile: OPP, BPP, AVRCP, A2DP
Tools: JTag, Trace32, Source Insight, Visual Studio, Rational Rose

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.locationName: Mapo District, Seoul, South Korea · On-site
positions.description:
Programmed UI, application layer, and DB access for Web based System Integration Groupware. I used C/C++, JSP, D-HTML, XML, and MySQL.
- Designed and implemented mail, invitation, and notice instance messenger for Intraworks 3.0 (Groupware by System Integration).
- Designed and implemented UI, address book, and application layer modules for Intraworks 3.0.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Seocho District, Seoul, South Korea · On-site
positions.description: Developed 3D architectural cad engine with C++/Java

positions.title: Co-Founder and CTO
positions.description: Worked as a CTO for a start-up. Created and managed a service portal for artists/designers.
